topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Code of conduct and POL-05 acknowledgment at hire and annually; sanctions under POL-01 4.8
evidence: Code of conduct; acknowledgment report (96% current); sanctions log

control_description: Board audit committee receives quarterly cyber risk, POA&M and readiness reports from the vCISO
gap: Quarterly cyber reporting formalized only from 2026-09; one meeting on record
remediation: Hold and minute each quarterly report through the observation period

control_description: CySO and alternate designated in writing; roles in POL-01 section 3 and the SSP; TOGP system owner is the COO
Annual security training; role-based training for the TOS application and portal teams; job descriptions for IT and security roles
gap: 42 employees trained late in 2026; no secure coding training for the portal team or the development contractor
remediation: Secure coding training for the portal team and contractor; training tracked monthly (POAM-004)

control_description: Control owners named in P02; performance objectives for the CySO and Security Manager include POA&M milestones
System inventory, data flows and logs support the portal and EDI controls
evidence: Cloud inventory; P04 diagram; SIEM source list
gap: TOS application audit log (portal and EDI transactions) not in the SIEM
remediation: Forward the TOS application audit log (POAM-005)

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Policies published on the intranet; security responsibilities in training and onboarding; portal support procedures
gap: Policy set effective only from 2026-10-01; standards still in draft
remediation: Issue standards per the P06 schedule; brief the portal and EDI teams

control_description: Portal terms of use; customer notices through the portal banner; carrier contacts for incidents
control_owner: Director of Commercial and Customer Service
gap: No published security commitments or vulnerability reporting channel for customers; system description not yet written
remediation: Security commitments in the portal terms; vulnerability disclosure address (STD-07); draft system description

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Risk appetite statements and objectives approved by the CEO
Annual SP 800-30 risk assessment with system-level views for the TOGP
Fraud risks considered: release and hold manipulation (R-012), business email compromise (R-020), false EDI (R-019)
gap: Customs hold overrides need one approver; release messages get syntax checks only
remediation: Two-person override and release message checks (POAM-028)

control_description: Significant changes (acquisitions, new services, ownership changes) trigger a risk assessment (POL-01 4.14)
gap: Rule is new; the T2 integration shows past changes were not assessed
remediation: Apply the acquisition checklist; assess the 2027 portal release plan

control_description: Annual independent assessment by the co-sourced internal audit firm; monthly KPI review
Deficiencies tracked in the POA&M and reported to the audit committee quarterly

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected from the Moderate baseline and mapped to risks (P02, P01)
General IT controls over the cloud, identity and portal infrastructure
gap: No documented hardening baselines for servers outside the cloud guardrails (STD-05)
remediation: Issue STD-05 and baselines (POAM-007)

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: Policies POL-01 to POL-05 approved 2026-09-15 with supporting standards
evidence: P06 policy set and standards index
gap: 8 standards in draft
remediation: Issue standards per the P06 schedule

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: Identity provider SSO and MFA for staff; email-verified customer accounts; web application firewall; privileged access broker in the cloud
evidence: Conditional access export; portal authentication settings
gap: MFA optional for trucking company administrator accounts; standing domain administrator accounts
remediation: Mandatory MFA for customer administrator accounts (2027-03-31); privileged access management (POAM-002)

control_description: Accounts provisioned from the HR feed with manager approval; customer administrator accounts verified by customer service
evidence: HR feed configuration; P07 sample of 25 new accounts (all approved)

control_description: Role-based access in the TOS and portal administration; removal at termination
gap: Transfers keep prior roles (3 of 25); semiannual reviews; gate module local accounts outside the identity provider; portal developers can release their own code
remediation: Transfer workflow, quarterly reviews, gate module accounts in the identity provider (POAM-001); release separation (POAM-020)

control_description: Cloud data centers (carved out, provider SOC 2); T1 gate server room badge-controlled with logs
Certified destruction of retired IT media; cloud storage deletion by the provider

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Web application firewall and denial-of-service protection for the portal; cloud firewall; no public management ports
evidence: WAF rule set; firewall exports; 2026-06 external test
gap: No annual penetration test commitment; external attack surface scanning not routine
remediation: Annual portal penetration test; monthly external surface scan (POAM-020)

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: TLS 1.2 or higher for the portal and APIs; AS2 or SFTP with EDI partners
gap: 2 carrier services still send EDI by plain FTP
remediation: Move both to SFTP or AS2 and retire FTP (POAM-023)

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: EDR on all servers in scope with 24x7 MSSP monitoring; container image scanning

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Monthly authenticated scans; weekly KEV review; cloud posture management; dependency scanning in the build pipeline
evidence: Scan reports; KEV log; pipeline settings
gap: 3 of 21 KEVs missed the 7-day target; no static analysis for the portal
remediation: KEV 72-hour target for internet-facing systems; static analysis (POAM-018, POAM-020)

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: MSSP 24x7 monitoring of identity, cloud, firewall, EDR and portal logs
evidence: MSSP monthly reports; P07 escalation test (14 minutes)
gap: TOS application audit log (EDI and release transactions) not monitored
remediation: Onboard the TOS application audit log (POAM-005)

control_description: MSSP triage and escalation within 30 minutes; CySO evaluation of security events
POL-03; ransomware runbook approved 2026-09-15; notification matrix
gap: Runbooks not exercised; full Cyber Incident Response Plan due 2026-12-31
remediation: Drill 2026-11-18; plan approved (POAM-014)

control_description: Recovery from the write-once backups and the standby region
gap: TOS restore took 6.5 h against a 4 h RTO; failover never tested; the portal has no recovery test
remediation: Failover test 2026-11-07; quarterly restore tests including the portal (POAM-010)

control_description: Change tickets, peer review and automated tests for portal and EDI changes; TOS vendor releases tested twice a year
evidence: Repository settings; P07 sample of 10 releases
gap: The development contractor can merge to production; no security testing in the pipeline; emergency changes not reviewed after the fact
remediation: Branch protection with company approval; static analysis; emergency change review (POAM-020)

control_description: BIA recovery objectives; cyber insurance ($15 million); manual procedures for portal and gate outages
gap: Contingency plan not aligned with the BIA (P07 CP-2)
remediation: New contingency plan (POAM-009)

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Vendor tiering and annual Tier 1 SOC 2 review program (Part B; STD-04)
gap: 14 of 27 vendors with access lack notification terms; 3 Tier 1 vendors have no assurance report
remediation: Contract amendments (POAM-019); obtain reports or alternatives from the 3 vendors

control_description: Cloud capacity monitoring and autoscaling for the portal; TOS database capacity reviewed monthly
Write-once backups in a second region; standby TOS database replica; provider environmental protections (carved out)
evidence: Backup console; vault lock settings; provider SOC 2

control_description: Recovery testing of the TOS, EDI gateway and portal
gap: No failover test; RTO not met; no portal or EDI recovery test
remediation: Failover and quarterly restore tests (POAM-010)

topic_label: Identification and maintenance of confidential information
control_description: Classification under POL-04; bills of lading, customs status and customer contracts classified Confidential or Restricted; driver license numbers tokenized in the portal
gap: Classification effective only from 2026-10-01; 2 EDI partners on FTP
remediation: Apply POL-04 labels to portal and EDI data stores; retire FTP (POAM-023)

control_description: Retention and disposal of customer data per contract and POL-04
gap: No retention limits for customer and driver data in the TOS and portal
remediation: Retention schedule and purge jobs (POAM-030)

control_description: EDI implementation guides for carriers and trucking; portal availability and appointment rules
evidence: EDI implementation guides; portal help pages
gap: Processing commitments (timeliness of status messages, appointment rules) not written as service commitments
remediation: Define processing commitments in the system description and carrier agreements

control_description: EDI syntax and container check-digit validation; portal input validation
evidence: EDI error log; portal validation rules
gap: No business-rule checks on release and hold changes from the customs data exchange
remediation: Release message checks and reconciliation report (POAM-028)

control_description: TOS processes gate, yard and vessel transactions; daily EDI message count reconciliation for 9 carrier services
gap: Reconciliation not performed for T2 customers or the customs data exchange feed
remediation: Extend daily reconciliation to all partners

control_description: Status messages to carriers; availability and invoices in the portal
gap: No completeness check that every status event produced an outbound message
remediation: Outbound completeness report with exception follow-up

control_description: TOS and portal databases encrypted, backed up with write-once retention; database integrity checks
